description: For infinite cardinals kappa and lambda, the lambda power of the successor of kappa equals kappa to the lambda times the successor of kappa.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.hausdorff_formula.{u} (κ τ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ) : Order.succ κ ^ τ = κ ^ τ * Order.succ κ
